title: Horizon signal delivery — POST {OSINT_DESK_BASE_URL}/api/v1/signals/inbound
description: Shared contract between Horizon and OSINT//DESK. Field names must not change without updating both repos.

signal_id.description: dispatches.id on the Horizon side; idempotency key for OSINT//DESK

signal_type.description: weak_signal and trend_breakout are detections: the engine noticed something anomalous. beat_match is a request being served: the newsroom asked to follow this subject, and the event matched it. The distinction is load-bearing at verdict time — 'this was not worth sending' means different things for a detector that misfired and for a beat the newsroom defined itself.

title.description: Cluster label or event summary, Thai

location.description: Where it happened, as the article said it. Horizon has extracted this since the beginning and it reached nobody: it was not in this schema, so it never travelled. Free text at whatever granularity the reporting used — อำเภอยะหา as readily as ไทย — and the receiver geocodes it.

cluster_id.description: Cluster the signal came from, so the receiver can ask Horizon for the full timeline. Null for a weak signal raised on a single unclustered event.

beat_id.description: The OSINT//DESK signal_profiles.id this matched. Null unless signal_type is beat_match.

beat_name.description: Name of the beat at the time of the match, for display when the beat is later renamed or deleted.

beat_reason.description: Why the engine judged this event to be on that beat, in Thai.
